checks.applicability: Applies to pages on which the library is detected: its window global (with its version field) or, for jQuery, Bootstrap, AngularJS, Lodash and Handlebars, a script URL whose path names the library and a version.
checks.expectation: Fails for every jQuery below 3.5.0 (from 1.0.3 by CVE-2020-11023, below 3.0.0 also by CVE-2015-9251); 3.5.0 and later pass. Detected through `jQuery.fn.jquery`, the `$` alias alone, or a script path naming the core build (jquery-3.6.0.min.js, /jquery/3.6.0/jquery.min.js, jquery@3.6.0). A plugin named after jQuery (jquery-ui, jquery.validate) is not jQuery and its version is not jQuery's; the host part of a URL (127.0.0.1) is never a version. A page without the library: not applicable. A page that breaks the detection scripts (result missing or malformed) is not run for every library, never clean.
